Trump mentions that major American investors are involved and that they are looking forward to closing the deal. When questioned if it's fully approved, he says he thinks so but that it still needs to be signed. He adds that he and President Xi discussed trade, Russia/Ukraine, and Gaza, and asserts that both China and young people in the U.S. want TikTok to remain operational.
